Full summary: Implemented triage engine core (TRIAGE-SPEC.md §3-§5, PR-stage 2 first half): TriageItem/TriageResult types in src/utils/types.ts, buildTriage in src/engine/triage.ts (two-phase read, all input normalization internal, injected stores + clock), and smoke tests in test/triage-engine.test.ts (16 tests). Full suite 1317 passed / 2 skipped, build clean.
Decisions: Chose a direct code-unit </> comparator for the (timestamp,id) ordering over the repo's localeCompare convention — the spec mandates a raw-string comparator and ICU collation treats hyphens as variable-weight, so localeCompare is not literally raw; results are identical for store-generated values but the code now matches the contract exactly.; Chose to re-check the recent-window cutoff against the full Decision record in phase 2 (not only at index narrowing) — an index/record status race (provisional at index read, active at full read) could otherwise admit an active decision to recent without the cutoff test; conservative, no cost.; Chose default parameters for buildTriage's now (() => new Date()) and input ({}) following the isDelegationExpired default-clock convention — no Date.now() inside the engine, tests inject a fixed clock.; Chose to define TriageInput/TriageStores in src/engine/triage.ts rather than types.ts — the spec mandates only TriageItem/TriageResult in types.ts; the input shape is the engine's contract with its adapters.; Applied defensive ?? '' on Decision.rationale and BlackboardEntry.detail before preview construction — the types declare them required but legacy on-disk records may lack them; a missing field must yield an omitted preview, not a crash.
